Awalan toh Nabi ﷺ sharaf-o-karamat ke taur par khatab kiya gaya phir taba'an aap ki ummat se khatab kiya gaya aur talaq ke masle ko samjhaya gaya, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Hafsa ko talaq di woh apne maike aa gayin is par yeh ayat utri aur aap se farmaya gaya ke un se rujoo karlo woh bahut zyada roza rakhne wali aur bahut zyada namaz parhne wali hain aur woh yahan bhi aap ki biwi hain aur jannat mein bhi aap ki azwaj mein dakhil hain, yehi riwayat mursalan Ibn Jarir mein bhi hai aur sanadon se bhi aayi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Hafsa ؓ ko talaq di phir rujoo karliya, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar ؓ ne apni biwi sahibah ko haiz ki halat mein talaq de di, Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar ؓ nahma ne apni biwi sahibah ko haiz ki halat mein talaq de di, Hazrat Umar ne yeh waqia Aan-Huzoor ﷺ se bayan kiya aap naraz hue aur farmaya isay chahiye ke rujoo karle phir haiz se pak hone tak roke rakhe phir doosra haiz aaye aur us se naha lein phir agar ji chahe talaq dein yani is pakizgi ki halat mein baat cheet karne se pehle yehi woh iddat hai jis ka hukum Allah Ta'ala ne diya hai yeh hadis aur bhi bahut si kitabon mein bahut si sanadon ke sath mazkoor hai, Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Ayman ke jo Azza ke maula hain Hazrat Abu Al-Zubair ke sunte hue Hazrat Ibn Umar ؓ se sawal kiya ke us shakhs ke bare mein aap kya farmate hain jis ne apni biwi ko haiz ki halat mein talaq di toh aap ne farmaya suno Ibn Umar ne apni biwi ko haiz ki halat mein Rasool Allah ﷺ ki zindagi mein talaq di toh Huzoor ﷺ ne hukum diya ke isay loota le chunancha Ibn Umar ne rujoo karliya aur yehi Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tha is us se pak hojane ke baad isay ikhtiyar hai khwah talaq de khwah basa le aur Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ne is ayat ki tilawat ki (tarjuma) (Muslim) doosri riwayat mein (tarjuma) yani tuhr ki halat mein jama' se pehle, bahut se buzurgon ne yehi farmaya hai, Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain yani haiz mein talaq na do, na us tuhr mein talaq do jis mein jama' ho chuka ho balki us waqt tak chhor de jab haiz aa jaye phir us se naha le tab ek talaq de, Hazrat Ikrama farmate hain iddat se murad tuhr hai, quru se murad haiz hai ya hamal ki halat mein, jab hamal zahir ho, jis tuhr mein mujamat kar chuka hai is mein talaq na de na maloom hamila hai ya nahi, yahin se ba-samajh ulama ne ahkam-e-talaq liye hain aur talaq ki do qismein ki hain talaq-e-sunnat aur talaq-e-bid'at, talaq-e-sunnat toh yeh hai ke tuhr ki yani pakizgi ki halat mein jama' karne se pehle talaq de de ya halat-e-hamal mein talaq de aur bid'i talaq yeh hai ke halat-e-haiz mein talaq de ya tuhr mein de lekin mujamat kar chuka ho aur maloom na ho ke hamal hai ya nahi? Talaq ki teesri qism bhi hai jo na talaq-e-sunnat hai na talaq-e-bid'at aur woh nabaligha ki talaq hai aur us aurat ki jise haiz ke aane se na-umidi ho chuki ho aur us aurat ki jis se dukhool na hua ho.

In sab ke ahkaam aur tafsili bahas ki jagah kutub-e-furoo hain na ke tafsir. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam, phir farman hai iddat ki hifazat karo is ki ibtida-o-inteha ki dekh bhal rakho aisa na ho ke iddat ki lambai aurat ko doosra khawand karne se rok de, aur is bare mein apne ibtida-o-inteha ki dekh bhal rakho aisa na ho ke iddat ki lambai aurat ko doosra khawand karne se rok de aur is bare mein apne Ma'bood-e-Haqiqi Parwardigar-e-Alam se darte raho, iddat ke zamane mein mutallaqa aurat ki rehaish ka makan khawand ke zimme hai woh use nikal na de aur na khud use nikalna jaiz hai kyunke woh apne khawand ke haq mein ruki hui hai (tarjuma) zina ko bhi shamil hai aur use bhi ke aurat apne khawand ko tang kare is ka khilaf kare aur eeza pohanchaye, ya bad-zubani aur kaj-khulqi shuru kar de aur apne kaamon se aur apni zaban se susral walon ko takleef pohanchaye toh in soorton mein beshak khawand ko jaiz hai ke use apne ghar se nikal bahar kare, yeh Allah Ta'ala ki muqarrar karda hadein hain is ki shari'at aur is ke bataye hue ahkaam hain. Jo shakhs in par amal na kare unhein be-hurmati ke sath tod de in se aage badh jaye woh apna hi bura karne wala aur apni jaan par zulm dhane wala hai shayad ke Allah koi nayi baat paida kar karde Allah ke iradon ko aur hone wali baaton ko koi nahi jaan sakta, iddat ka zamana mutallaqa aurat ko khawand ke ghar guzarne ka hukm dena is maslahat se hai ke mumkin hai is muddat mein is ke khawand ke khayalat badal jayen, talaq dene par nadam ho dil mein lota lene ka khayal paida ho jaye aur phir rujoo kar ke dono miyan biwi amn-o-aman se guzara karne lagein, naya kaam paida karne se murad bhi raj'at hai, isi bina par ba'z salaf aur un ke tabieen masalan Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal waghera ka mazhab hai ke maboota yani woh aurat jis ki talaq ke baad khawand ko raj'at ka haq baqi na raha ho is ke liye iddat guzarne ke zamane tak makan ka dena khawand ke zimme nahi, isi tarah jis aurat ka khawand faut ho jaye use bhi rehaishi makan iddat tak ke liye dena is ke warison par nahi un ki etimadi daleel Hazrat Fatimah bint Qais Fahriyah wali hadith hai ke jab un ke khawand Hazrat Abu Umar bin Hafs ne un ko teesri aakhri talaq di aur woh us waqt yahan mojood na the balki yaman mein the aur wahin se talaq di thi toh un ke wakeel ne un ke paas thode se joo bhej diye the ke yeh tumhari khorak hai yeh bahut naraz huin us ne kaha bigadti kyun ho? Tumhara nafqah khana peena hamare zimme nahi, yeh Rasulullah ﷺ ke paas ayin Aap ne farmaya theek hai tera nafqah us par nahi.

Muslim mein hai na tere rehne sehne ka ghar aur un se farmaya ke tum Umm-e-Shareek ke ghar apni iddat guzaaro, phir farmaya wahan to mere aksar sahaba jaya aaya karte hain tum Abdullah bin Umm-e-Maktoom ke haan apni iddat ka zamaana guzaaro woh ek naabeena aadmi hain tum wahan aaram se apne kapre bhi rakh sakti ho, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke un ke khawand ko Huzoor ﷺ ne kisi jehad par bheja tha unhon ne wahin se unhein talaq bhej di un ke bhai ne un se kaha ke hamare ghar se chale jao unhon ne kaha nahi jab tak iddat khatam na hojaye mera khana peena aur rehna sehna mere khawand ke zimma hai us ne inkaar kiya aakhir Huzoor ﷺ ke paas yeh maamla pohncha jab aap ko maloom huwa ke yeh aakhri teesri talaq hai tab aap ne Hazrat Fatimah se farmaya naan nafaqah ghar baar khawand ke zimma is soorat mein hai ke usay haq-e-raj'at haasil ho jab yeh nahi to woh bhi nahi tum yahan se chale jao aur fulaan aurat ke ghar apni iddat guzaaro phir farmaya wahan to sahaba ki aamad-o-raft hai tum Ibn-e-Umm-e-Maktoom ke ghar iddat ka zamaana guzaaro woh naabeena hain tumhe dekh nahi sakte. Tabrani mein hai yeh Hazrat Fatimah bint-e-Qais Zahhak bin Qais Qurashi ki behan thi unke khawand Makhzoomi qabeela ke thay, talaq ki khabar ke baad un ke nafaqah talab karne par un ke khawand ke auliya ne kaha tha na to tumhare miyan ne kuch bheja hai na humein dene ko kaha hai aur Huzoor ﷺ ke farman mein yeh bhi marwi hai ke jab aurat ko woh talaq mil jaye jis ke baad woh apne agle khawand par haraam ho jati hai jab tak doosre se nikah aur phir talaq na hojaye to is soorat mein iddat ka naan nafaqah aur rehne ka makaan us ke khawand ke zimma nahi.

Irshad hota hai ke iddat wali auraton ki iddat jab poori hone ke qareeb pahunch jaye toh unke khawandon ko chahiye ke do baaton mein se ek karlein ya toh unhein bhalayi aur sulook ke sath apne hi nikah mein rok rakhein yaani talaq jo di thi us se rujoo kar ke baqaida us ke sath bood-o-bash rakhein ya unhein talaq de dein, lekin bura bhala kahe baghair gaali galoch diye baghair sarz-nish aur daant-dupat ke baghair bhalayi achhayi aur khoobsurati ke sath. (Yeh yaad rahe ke raj'at ka ikhtiyar us waqt hai jab ek talaq huyi ho ya do huyi hon) phir farmaya hai agar raj'at ka irada ho aur raj'at karo yaani luta lo toh us par do aadil musalman gawah rakh lo, Abu Dawood aur Ibn Majah mein hai ke Hazrat Imran bin Hussain R.A se daryaft kiya gaya ke ek shakhs apni biwi ko talaq deta hai phir us se jama' karta hai na talaq par gawah rakhta hai na raj'at par toh aap ne farmaya us ne khilaf-e-sunnat talaq di aur khilaf-e-sunnat rujoo kiya talaq par bhi gawah rakhna chahiye aur raj'at par bhi, ab dobara aisa na karna. Hazrat Ata R.H farmate hain nikah, raj'at baghair do aadil gawahon ke jaiz nahi jaise farman-e-Ilahi hai han majboori ho toh aur baat hai, phir farmata hai gawah muqarrar karne aur sachi shahadat dene ka hukm unhein ho raha hai jo Allah par aur aakhirat ke din par iman rakhte hon Allah ki shariat ke pabind aur azab-e-aakhirat se darne wale hon. Hazrat Imam Shafi'i farmate hain raj'at par gawah rakhna wajib hai go aap se ek doosra qool bhi marwi hai isi tarah nikah par gawah rakhna bhi aap wajib batate hain ek aur jamalat ka bhi yehi qool hai, is masle ko manne wale ulama-e-kiram ki jama'at yeh bhi kehti hai ke raj'at zubani kahe baghair sabit nahi hoti kyunke gawah rakhna zaroori hai aur jab tak zabaan se na kahe gawah kaise muqarrar kiye jayenge phir farmata hai ke jo shakhs ahkam-e-Allah baja laye us ki haram karda cheezon se parheiz kare Allah Ta'ala us ke liye mukhlasi paida kar deta hai ek aur jagah hai is tarah rizq pohanchata hai ke us ke khwab-o-khayal mein bhi na ho. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abu Zar R.A farmate hain ek martaba mere samne Rasool Allah ﷺ ne is aayat ki tilawat ki phir farmaya aye Abu Zar agar tamam log sirf ise hi le lein toh kafi hai, phir aap ne baar baar is ki tilawat shuru ki yahan tak ke mujhe ongh aane lagi phir aap ne farmaya Abu Zar tum kya karoge jab tumhe Madina se nikal diya jayega ? Jawab diya ke main aur kushadagi aur rahmat ki taraf chala jaunga yaani Makkah Shareef ko, wahin ka kabootar ban kar reh jaunga, aap ne farmaya phir kya karoge jab tumhe wahan se bhi nikala jayega ? Main ne kaha Sham ki pak zameen mein chala jaunga farmaya jab Sham se nikala jayega toh kya karega ? Main ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ Allah ki qasam jis ne aap ko haq ke sath paighambar bana kar bheja hai phir toh apni talwar apne kandhe par rakh kar muqabale par utr aunga, aap ne farmaya kya main tujhe is se behtar tarkeeq bataoon ?

Maine kaha haan Huzoor ﷺ zaroor irshad ho farmaya sunta reh aur manta reh agarche habshi ghulam ho, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood ؓ farmate hain ke Quran-e-Kareem mein bahut hi jami ayat (tarjuma) hai aur sab se zyada kushadgi ka wada is ayat (tarjuma) al-kh, mein hai, Musnad Ahmad mein Farman-e-Rasool ﷺ hai ke jo shakhs bakasrat istighfar karta rahe Allah Ta'ala use har gham se nijat aur har tangi se farakhi dega aur aisi jagah se rizq pohchaega jahan ka use khayal aur guman tak na ho, Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain use Allah Ta'ala duniya aur aakhirat ke har karb o be-chaini se نجات dega, Rabie farmate hain logon par kaam bhari ho us par asan hojayega, Hazrat Ikrama farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke jo shakhs apni biwi ko Allah ke hukm ke mutabiq talaq dega Allah use nakasi aur nijat dega, Ibn Masood waghera se marwi hai ke woh janta hai ke Allah agar chahe de agar na chahe na de, Hazrat Qatada farmate hain tamam umoor ke shubah se aur maut ki takleef se bacha lega aur rozi aisi jagah se dega jahan ka guman bhi na ho, Hazrat Suddi farmate hain yahan Allah se darne ke yeh maani hain ke sunnat ke mutabiq talaq de aur sunnat ke mutabiq rujoo kare, Aap farmate hain Hazrat Auf bin Malik Ashjai ؓ ke sahabzade ko kuffar giraftar kar ke le gaye aur unhe jail khane mein dal diya unke walid Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aksar aate aur apne bete ki halat aur hajat museebat aur takleef bayan karte rehte Aap unhe sabr karne ki talqeen karte aur farmate anqareeb Allah Ta'ala unke chhutkare ki sabeel bana dega, thode din guzre honge ke unke bete dushmanon mein se nikal bhage rasta mein dushmanon ki bakriyon ka reewad mil gaya jise apne sath hanka laye aur bakriyan liye hue apne walid ki khidmat mein ja pahuche pas yeh ayat utri ke muttaqi bandon ko Allah nijat de deta hai aur is ka guman bhi na ho wahan se use rozi pohchata hai, Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke gunah ki wajah se insan apni rozi se mahroom hojata hai taqdeer ko lotane wali cheez sirf dua hai umr mein ziyadati karne wali cheez sirf neki aur khush salooki hai.

Sirat Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai ke Hazrat Malik bin Ashja'i R.A ke larke Hazrat Auf R.A jab kafiron ki qaid mein thay toh Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya un se kehwa do ke bakasrat (Tarjuma) parhta rahey, ek din achanak baithey baithey un ki qaid khul gayi aur yeh wahan se nikal bhagey aur un logon ki ek oontni hath lag gayi jis par sawar ho liye rastey mein un ke oonton ke rewar miley unhein bhi apke sath hanka laye woh log peechay douray lekin yeh kisi ke hath na lagey seedhey apney ghar aaye aur darwazay par khare ho kar awaz di baap ne awaz sun kar farmaya Allah ki qasam yeh toh Auf hai maan ne kaha haaye woh kahan woh toh qaid-o-band ki museebatein jheel raha hoga ab dono maan baap aur khadim darwazay ki taraf douray darwaza khola toh un ke larke Hazrat Auf R.A hain aur tamam anganai oonton se bhari pari hai poocha ke yeh oont kaisay hain unhon ne waqia bayan farmaya kaha acha thehro mein Huzoor ﷺ se un ki babat masala daryaft kar aaon Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya woh sab tumhara maal hai jo chaho karo aur yeh ayat utri ke Allah se darnay walon ki mushkil Allah asan karta hai aur beguman rozi pohanchata hai, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs har taraf se khich kar Allah ka hojaye Allah us ki har mushkil mein usay kifayat karta hai aur beguman roziyan deta hai aur jo Allah se hat kar dunya hi ka hojaye Allah bhi usay usi ke hawalay kar deta hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A Huzoor ﷺ ke sath ap ki sawari par ap ke peechay baithey huway thay jo ap ne farmaya bachay mein tumhein chand batein sikhata hoon suno tum Allah ko yaad rakho woh tumhein yaad rakhay ga Allah ke ahkaam ki hifazat karo toh Allah ko apney paas balkay apney samnay paogay jab kuch mangna ho Allah hi se mango jab madad talab karni ho usi se madad chaho tamam ummat mil kar tumhein nafa pohanchana chahay aur Allah ko manzoor na ho toh zara sa bhi nafa nahi pohncha sakti aur isi tarah saray ke saray jama ho kar tujhey koi nuqsan pohanchana chaein toh bhi nahi pohncha sakte agar taqdeer mein na likha ho qalamen uth chuki hain aur sahifay khushk hogaye hain, Tirmizi mein bhi yeh hadith hai, Imam Tirmizi R.H isay Hasan Sahih kehtay hain Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aur hadith mein hai jisay koi hajat ho aur woh logon ki taraf lay jaye toh bohat mumkin hai ke woh sakhti mein parjaye aur kaam mushkil hojaye aur jo apni hajat Allah ki taraf lay jaye Allah Ta'ala zaroor us ki murad poori karta hai ya toh jaldi isi dunya mein hi ya dair ke sath mout ke baad. Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala apnay qaza aur ahkaam jis tarah aur jaisay chahay apni makhlooq mein pooray karnay wala aur achi tarah jari karnay wala hai. Har cheez ka us ne andaza muqarrar kiya huwa hai jaisay aur jagah hai (Tarjuma) har cheez us ke paas ek andazay se hai.

mil kar tumhein nafa pohanchana chahay aur Allah ko manzoor na ho toh zara sa bhi nafa nahi pohncha sakti aur isi tarah saray ke saray jama ho kar tujhey koi nuqsan pohanchana chaein toh bhi nahi hadith mein hai jisay koi hajat ho aur woh logon ki taraf lay jaye toh bohat mumkin hai ke woh sakhti mein parjaye aur kaam mushkil hojaye aur jo apni hajat Allah ki taraf lay jaye Allah Ta'ala zaroor us ki murad poori karta hai ya toh jaldi isi dunya mein hi ya dair ke sath mout ke baad. Phir irshad hota hai ke Allah Ta'ala apnay qaza aur ahkaam jis tarah aur jaisay chahay apni makhlooq mein pooray karnay wala aur achi tarah jari karnay wala hai. Har cheez ka us ne andaza muqarrar kiya huwa hai jaisay aur jagah hai (Tarjuma) har cheez us ke paas ek andazay se hai.

Masail-e-Iddat: Jin burhiya aurton ki apni bari umr ki wajah se ayam band hogaye hon, yahan un ki iddat batayi jati hai ke teen mahine ki iddat guzarrein, jaise ke ayam wali aurton ki iddat teen haiz hai. Mulahiza ho Surah Al-Baqarah ki ayat. Isi tarah woh larkiyan jo us umr ko nahi pohnchi ke unhein haiz aaye, un ki iddat bhi yahi teen mahine rakhi. Agar tumhein shak ho, is ki tafsir mein do qoul hain: Ek toh yeh ke khoon dekh lein aur tumhein shuba guzre ke aya haiz ka khoon hai ya istihaza ki bimari ka, dusra qoul yeh hai ke un ki iddat ke hukm mein tumhein shak baqi reh jaye aur tum use na pehchan sako toh teen mahine yaad rakh lo. Yeh dusra qoul hi zyada zahir hai, is ki dalil yeh riwayat bhi hai ke Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab ne kaha tha: Ya Rasoolallah ﷺ! Bohat si aurton ki iddat abhi bayan nahi hui; kamsan larkiyan, burhi bari auratein aur hamal wali auratein. Us ke jawab mein yeh ayat utri. Phir hamila ki iddat bayan farmayi ke waza'-e-hamal is ki iddat hai, go talaq ya khawand ki mout ke zara si der baad hi hojaye, jaise ke is ayah-e-karima ke alfaz hain aur Ahadis-e-Nabawiyyah se sabit hai aur jumhoor ulama-e-salaf-o-khalaf ka qoul hai. 

Haan, Hazrat Ali aur Hazrat Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke Surah Al-Baqarah ki ayat aur is ayat ko mila kar un ka fatwa yeh hai ke in dono mein se jo zyada der mein khatam ho, woh iddat yeh guzarre yaani agar bacha teen mahine se pehle paida hogaya toh teen mahine ki iddat hai aur teen mahine guzar chuke aur bacha nahi hua toh bache ke hone tak iddat hai. 

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Salmah se riwayat hai ke ek shakhs Hazrat Ibn Abbas ke paas aaya aur us waqt Hazrat Abu Hurairah bhi wahin maujood thay. Us ne sawal kiya ke us aurat ke bare mein aap ka kya fatwa hai jise apne khawand ke intiqal ke baad chaliswein din bacha hojaye? Aap ne farmaya: Dono iddaton mein se aakhri iddat ise guzarani paregi, yaani is surat mein teen mahine ki iddat is par hai. Abu Salmah ne kaha: Quran mein toh hai ke hamal waliyon ki iddat bacha ka peda hojana hai. Hazrat Abu Hurairah ne farmaya: Main bhi apne chacha zad bhai Hazrat Abu Salmah ke sath hoon, yaani mera bhi yahi fatwa hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas ne usi waqt apne ghulam Kuraib ko Ummu Salamah (R.A) ke paas bheja ke jao un se yeh masla pooch aao. Unhon ne farmaya: Subi'ah Aslamiyyah ke shauhar qatal kiye gaye aur yeh us waqt ummeed se theen, chalis raton ke baad bacha hogaya, usi waqt nikah ka paigham aaya aur An-Hazrat ﷺ ne nikah kardiya, paigham dene walon mein Hazrat Abu Usanabil bhi thay.

Yeh hadith qadray tawalat ke sath aur kitabon mein bhi hai, Hazrat Abdullah bin Utbah ne Hazrat Umar bin Abdullah bin Arqam Zahri ko likha ke woh Sabiya bint Haris Aslamiya ke paas jayen aur un se un ka waqia daryaft kar ke unhein likh bhejein, yeh gaye daryaft kiya aur likha ke un ke khawand Hazrat Saad bin Khaula R.A thay yeh badri sahabi thay Hajjat-ul-Wada' mein faut hogaye us waqt yeh haml se thin thore hi din ke baad unhein bacha paida hogaya jab nifas se pak huin toh achhe kapre pehn kar banao singhar kar ke baith gayin Hazrat Abu-us-Sanabil bin Balak jab un ke paas aaye toh unhein is halat mein dekh kar kehne lage tum jo is tarah baithi ho toh kya nikah karna chahti ho Wallah tum nikah nahi kar sakteen jab tak ke chaar mahine das din nah guzar jayen. Main yeh sun kar chadar orh Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hui aur Aap se yeh masala pucha Aap ne farmaya bacha paida hote hi tum iddat se nikal gayin ab tumhein ikhtiyar hai agar chaho to apna nikah kar lo (Muslim). 

Sahih Bukhari mein is ayat ke tahet mein is hadith ke warid karne ke baad yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Muhammad bin Sirin ek majlis mein thay jahan Hazrat Abdulرحمن bin Abu Yali bhi thay jin ki tazeem o takreem un ke sathi bahut hi kiya karte thay unhon ne hamla ki iddat akhri do iddaton ki miyad batai is par main ne Hazrat Sabiya wali hadith bayan ki, is par mere ba'z sathi mujhe tahoke lagane lage main ne kaha phir to main ne bari jurrat ki agar Abdullah par main ne bohtan bandha halankah woh Kufa ke kone mein zinda maujud hain pas woh zara sharma gaye aur kehne lage lekin un ke chacha to yeh nahi kehte main Hazrat Abu Atiya Malik bin Amir se mila unhon ne mujhe Hazrat Sabiya wali hadith puri sunai main ne kaha tum ne is babat Hazrat Abdullah se bhi kuch suna hai ? Farmaya yeh Hazrat Abdullah kehte thay Aap ne farmaya kya tum is par sakhti karte ho aur rukhsat nahi dete ?

Talaq ke baad bhi sulook ki hidayat:

Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko hukum deta hai ki jab un mein se koi apni biwi ko talaq de toh iddat ke guzar jaane tak uske rehne sehne ko apna makan de, yeh jagah apni taaqat ke mutabiq hai yahan tak ke Hazrat Qatadah R.H farmate hain agar zyada wusat na ho toh apne hi makan ka ek kona use de de, use takleefein pohncha kar is qadar tang na karo ki woh makan chhod kar chali jaye ya tumse chhootne ke liye apna haq-e-mahar chhod de ya is tarah ki talaq di dekha ki woh ek roz iddat ke reh gaye hain rujoo ka ailaan kar diya phir talaq de di aur iddat ke khatam hone ke qareeb raj'at karli taaki na woh bechari sahagan rahe na raand, phir irshad hota hai ki agar talaq wali aurat hamal se ho toh bacha hone tak ka naan-o-nafaqah uske khawand ke zimmah hai, aksar ulama ka farman hai ki yeh khas un auraton ke liye bayan ho raha hai jinhe aakhri talaq de di gayi ho jis se rujoo karne ka haq unke khawandon ko na raha ho isliye ki jin se rujoo ho sakta hai unki iddat tak ka kharch toh khawand ke zimmah hai hi woh hamal se hon tab aur be-hamal hon toh bhi aur hazrat ulama farmate hain yeh hukum bhi unhi auraton ka bayan ho raha hai jinse raj'at ka haq hasil hai kyunki upar bhi unhi ka bayan tha ise alag isliye bayan kar diya ki aumuman hamal ki muddat lambi hoti hai is lamhe koi yeh na samajh baithe ki iddat ke zamane jitna nafaqah toh hamare zimmah hai phir nahi isliye saaf taur par farma diya ki raj'at wali talaq ke waqt agar aurat hamal se ho toh jab tak bacha na ho uska khilana pilana khawand ke zimmah hai. 

Phir ismein bhi ulama ka ikhtilaf hai ki kharch uske liye hamal ke waste se hai ya hamal ke liye hai, Imam Shafi'i waghera se dono qoul marwi hain aur is bina par bahut se furoo'i masail mein bhi ikhtilaf ruma huwa hai. 

Phir farmata hai ki jab yeh mutalaqah auratein hamal se farigh ho jayein toh agar tumhari aulad ko woh doodh pilayein toh tumhe unki doodh pilayi deni chahiye. Haan aurat ko ikhtiyar hai khwah doodh pilaye ya na pilaye lekin awwal dafa ka doodh use zaroor pilana chahiye go phir doodh na pilaye kyunki aumuman bacha ki zindagi is doodh ke sath wabasta hai agar woh baad mein bhi doodh pilati rahe toh maa baap ke darmiyan jo ujrat tay ho jaye woh ada karni chahiye, tum mein aapas mein jo kaam hon woh bhlai ke sath baqaidah dastoor ke mutabiq hone chahiye na uske nuqsaan ke darpay rahe na woh use aiza pohnchane ki koshish kare, jaise Surah Al-Baqarah mein farmaya (Tarjumah) yani bacha ke bare mein na uski maa ko zaroor pohnchaya jaye na uske baap ko.

Phir farmata hai agar aapas mein ikhtilaaf barh jaye masalan larke ka baap kam dena chahta hai aur uski maan ko manzoor nahi ya maan zaaid maangti hai jo baap par giraan hai aur muwafiqat nahi hosakti dono kisi baat par razamand nahi hote toh ikhtiyar hai ke kisi aur daya ko dein haan jo aur daya ko diya jana manzoor kiya jata hai agar usi par us bacha ki maan razamand hojaye toh ziyada mustahiq yahi hai, phir farmata hai ke bachay ka baap ya wali jo wus at rakhta ho usay chahiye ke bachay par apni wus'at ke mutabiq kharch kare, tangi wala apni taaqat ke mutabiq day, taaqat se barh kar تکلیف kisi ko Allah nahi deta, Tafsir Ibn Jareer mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Ubaidah ki baabat Hazrat Umar ne daryaft kiya toh maaloom hua ke woh mota kapra pehte hain aur halki ghiza khatay hain aap ne hukum diya ke unhein aik hazaar dinaar bhijwa do aur jis ke haath bhijwaye un se keh diya ke dekhna woh un dinaaron ko pa kar kya karte hain? Jab yeh ashrafiyan unhein mil gayeen toh unhon ne bareek kapre pehnnay aur nihayat nafees ghizayein khani shuru karden, qaasid ne wapas aa kar Hazrat Umar R.A se waqia bayan kiya aap ne farmaya Allah us par raham kare us ne is aayat par amal kiya ke kushadgi wala apni kushadgi ke mutabiq kharch kare aur tangi o tershi wala apni halat ke muwafiq, Tabarani ki aik ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jis shakhs ke paas das dinaar thay us ne un mein se aik raah Allah sadqa kiya doosre ke paas das oqiyah thay us ne us mein se aik oqiyah yaani chaalis darham kharch kiye teesre ke paas sau oqiyah thay jis mein se us ne Allah ke naam par das oqiyah kharch kiye toh yeh sab ajr mein Allah ke nazdeek barabar hain is liye ke har aik ne apnay maal ka daswan hissa fi sabilillah diya hai, phir Allah Ta'ala sacha wada deta hai ke woh tangi ke baad aasaani kar dega jaise aur jagah farmaya (tarjuma) tahqeeq ke sath aasaani hai, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith is jagah warid karne ke qabil hai jis mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ne farmaya aglay zamanay mein aik miyan biwi thay jo faqr o faqa se apni zindagi guzar rahe thay paas kuch bhi na tha aik martaba yeh shakhs safar se aaya aur sakht bhooka tha bhook ke maaray betaab tha aate hi apni biwi se pucha kuch khanay ko hai? Us ne kaha aap khush hojaiye Allah Ta'ala ki di hui rozi hamaray haan aa pohunchi hai us ne kaha phir lao jo kuch ho day do mein bohat bhooka hoon. Anjam-e-kar nuqsan uthaya us waqt nadim hone lage lekin ab nadamat kis kaam ki? Phir duniya ke is azab se hi agar palla pak ho jata toh jab bhi ek baat thi, nahi toh phir unke liye akhirat mein bhi sakht-tar azab aur be-panah maar hai, ab ae soch samajh walo chahiye ki un jaise na bano aur unke anjam se ibrat hasil karo, ae aqalmand imanwaron Allah ne tumhari taraf Quran-e-Karim nazil farma diya hai, Zikr se murad Quran hai jaise aur jagah farmaya (tarjuma) al-kh., Hum ne is Quran ko nazil farmaya aur hum hi iski hifazat karne wale hain aur baaz ne kaha hai Zikr se murad yahan Rasul hai chunache sath hi farmaya hai Rasulan toh yeh badal-e-ishtimal hai, chunke Quran ke phunchane wale Rasulullah ﷺ hi hain toh is munasibat se Aap ko lafz Zikr se yaad kiya gaya, Hazrat Imam Ibn Jarir bhi isi matlab ko durust batate hain, phir Rasul ﷺ ki halat bayan farmai ki woh Allah ki wazeh aur roshan aayetein padh sunate hain taaki Musalman andheron se nikal aayein aur roshniyon mein pahunch jayein, jaise aur jagah hai (Alif Lam Ra, Kitabun anzalnahu ilaika litukhrijan-nasa minaz-zulumati ilan-nuri bi-izni rabbihim ila siratil-azizil-hamid) (14. Ibrahim: 1), Is Kitab ko hum ne tujhe diya hai taaki tu logon ko tareekiyon se roshni mein laye ek aur jagah irshad hai (Allahu waliyyul-lazina amanu yukhrijuhum minaz-zulumati ilan-nuri wal-lazina kafaru awliya'uhumut-taghutu yukhrijunahum minan-nuri ilaz-zulumati ula'ika ashabun-nari hum fiha khalidun) (2. Al-Baqarah: 257), Allah iman walon ka kar-saz hai woh unhein andheron se ujale ki taraf lata hai, yaani kufr-o-jahalat se iman-o-ilm ki taraf, chunache aur aayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne apni nazil karda wahi ko noor farmaya hai kyunki isse hidayat aur rah-e-rast hasil hoti hai aur isi ka naam Ruh bhi rakha hai kyunki isse dilon ki zindagi milti hai, chunache irshad-e-bari hai: (Tarjuma) Yaani hum ne isi tarah teri taraf apne hukm se ruh ki wahi ki tu nahi janta tha ki Kitab kya hai aur iman kya hai? Lekin hum ne ise noor kar diya jiske sath hum apne jis bande ko chahein hidayat karte hain yaqinan tu sahi aur sachi rah ki rahbari karta hai, phir imanwaron aur nek amal walon ka badla bahti nahron wali hamesha rehne wali Jannat bayan hua hai jiski tafsir barha guzar chuki hai.

Hairat-afza shan-e-Zul-Jalal Allah Ta'ala apni qudrat-e-kamilah aur apni azeem-ush-shan saltanat ka zikr farmata hai taake makhlooq us ki azmat aur izzat ka khayal kar ke us ke farman ko qadr ki nigaah se dekhe aur us par amil ban kar use khush kare, to farmaya ke saton aasmano ka khaliq Allah Ta'ala hai, jaise Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ne apni qaum se farmaya tha (tarjumah) kya tum nahi dekhte ke Allah Pak ne saton aasmano ko kis tarah ooper tale paida kiya hai? aur jagah irshad hai (tarjumah) yani saton aasman aur zameen aur un mein jo kuch hai sab us Allah ki tasbeeh parhte rehte hain, phir farmata hai usi ki misal zameenein hain, jaise ke Bukhari aur Muslim ki sahih hadith mein hai jo shakhs zulm kar ke kisi ki ek baalisht bhar zameen le lega use saton zameeno ka tauq pehnaya jaye ga, sahih بخاری (Bukhari) mein hai use satween zameen tak dhunsaya jaye ga, main ne is ki tamam sanadein aur kul alfaaz ibtida aur intiha mein zameen ki paidaish ke zikr mein bayan kar diye hain, fa Alhamdulillah, jin ba'z logo ne kaha hai ke is se murad haft iqleem hai unho ne be-faidah daur bhaag ki hai aur ikhtilaf-e-beja mein phans gaye hain aur bila daleel Quran-o-Hadith ka sareeh khilaf kiya hai Surah Hadid mein ayat (هُوَ الْاَوَّلُ وَالْاٰخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۚ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ) (57. Al-Hadid: 3) ki tafseer mein saton zameeno ka aur un ke darmiyan ki doori ka aur un ki motai ka jo paanch sau saal ki hai poora bayan ho chuka hai, Hazrat Ibn Masood (R.A) waghera bhi yahi farmate hain, ek aur hadith mein bhi hai saton aasman aur jo kuch un mein aur un ke darmiyan hai aur saton zameenein aur jo kuch un mein aur un ke darmiyan hai Kursi ke muqabla mein aise hain jaise kisi lambe choure bohat bare chatel maidan mein ek challa para ho, Ibn Jareer mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke agar main is ki tafseer tumhare samne bayan karoon to use na mano ge aur na manna jhoota jaanna hai, aur riwayat mein hai ke kisi shakhs ne is ayat ka matlab poocha tha us par aap ne farmaya tha ke main kaise bawar kar loon ke jo main tujhe bataoon ga to us ka inkar karega?

Aur riwayat mein marwi hai ke har zameen mein misal Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ke aur us zameen ki makhlooq ke hai aur Ibn Manna wali is riwayat mein aaya hai har aasman mein misal Ibrahim ke hai, Baihaqi ki kitab Al-Asma was-Sifat mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ka qool hai ke saton zameenon mein se har ek mein Nabi hai misal tumhare Nabi ke aur Adam hain misal Adam ke aur Noh hain misal Noh ke aur Ibrahim hain misal Ibrahim ke aur Isa hain misal Isa ke phir Imam Baihaqi ne ek aur riwayat bhi Ibn Abbas ki warid ki hai aur farmaya hai is ki asnad sahih hai lekin yeh bilkul shaz hai Abu-uz-Zuha jo is ke ek rawi hain mere ilm mein to un ki mutaba'at koi nahi karta, Wallahu A'lam. Ek mursal aur bahut hi munkar riwayat Ibn Abi ad-Dunya laaye hain jis mein marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek martaba Sahaba ke majma' mein tashreef laaye dekha ke sab kisi ghor o fikr mein chup chaap hain, poocha kya baat hai? Jawab mila Allah ki makhlooq ke bare mein soch rahe hain farmaya theek hai makhlooqaat par nazrein daurao lekin kahin Allah ki zaat par ghor o khoz mein na parjana, suno is maghrib ki taraf ek safed zameen hai us ki safedi us ka noor hai ya farmaya us ka noor us ki safedi hai suraj ka rasta chalis din ka hai wahan Allah ki ek makhlooq hai jis ne ek aankh jhapne ke barabar bhi kabhi us ki nafarmani nahi ki, Sahaba ne kaha phir Shaitan un se kahan hai? Farmaya unhe yeh bhi nahi maloom ke Shaitan paida bhi kiya gaya hai ya nahi? Poocha kya woh bhi insan hain? Farmaya unhe Hazrat Adam ki paidaish ka bhi ilm nahi, Alhamdulillah Surah Talaq ki tafseer bhi poori hui.
